args.title: Fix currency symbol recognition in parseAmount function
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The parseAmount function currently fails to recognize the Indian rupee symbol (₹) which causes valid bank import files to fail. We need to update the function to include ₹ and potentially other currency symbols.

The `parseAmount` function does not recognize the Indian rupee symbol (`₹`), causing imports to fail. The function needs updating to handle ₹ and other currency symbols, to parse correctly.
